one_line: An autonomous Krakauer boundary search over #51's agents, repos, rooms and 140 meaning elements finds no system larger than one atom that holds out of sample at 30 min; agents are individuals only at the day scale (1/27 within-day, 20/27 cross-day post hoc).

v2.claim: In #51 (07-06 to 09-04, 30-min bins, odd/even day split), an autonomous Krakauer boundary search over 32 agents, 33 repos, 2 rooms and 140 meaning elements finds no system larger than one atom that holds out of sample in both directions (0/16 agent-level and 1/72 element-level local maxima hold one way; rotated data give as many maxima), and only 1 of 27 agents beats a within-day permutation of its own states.
